extensions.name: plasma
extensions.description: Classic three-wave interference plasma with tunable foreground and background colors, speed, and an invert toggle - formerly the in-repo C++ extension, now sinf-based
extensions.author: skalldri

extensions.name: demo_wave
extensions.description: Audio-reactive wave: parameterized crest color and speed, amplitude swells with audio energy, beats flash the crest column
extensions.author: skalldri

extensions.name: mask_eyes
extensions.description: Symbolic LED eyes with glitchy transitions, modelled on Watch_Dogs 2's Wrench: idles on X X, tilts and vigorous head motion via the IMU, startles on sharp sound, plus manual expressions on the buttons; Calm/Lively profiles with numeric override params
extensions.author: skalldri
